title: RunRoom DO: dispatch lease and pending-question store
description: Replace the placeholder RunRoom with the two pieces of state that are filesystem-shaped today. (1) The dispatch lease, one per project, idFromName(project): acquire returns the holder run_id on conflict rather than blocking, release is compare-and-delete so a stale holder cannot free a newer lease, and a DO alarm expires an abandoned lease. This is the SAME lease a local run takes on an enrolled project (D19) - exactly one arbiter per project. (2) The pending-question store replacing .tick/pending plus flock, with first-wins arbitration across surfaces and an already-answered-by response to losers (D5). This tick owns src/run-room.ts and is the contract three later ticks consume, so it lands alone in its wave and gets a foundation review before dependents start.
